exercises.prompt: Tell us about a time you saw or experienced a dangerous traffic situation.
Some people prefer to walk or cycle for short trips, while others prefer to use a car. Which do you prefer, and why?
A city is considering installing more security cameras in public spaces. What are the advantages and disadvantages?
Your city is proposing to lower the speed limit on all residential streets to improve safety. I am a member of the city council. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
